q: Who made the most tackles in the last 20 minutes of Premier League matches in 2015/16?
gold: SELECT e.player, count(*) n FROM events e JOIN matches m USING (match_id) WHERE m.competition='Premier League' AND m.season='2015/2016' AND e.type='Tackle' AND e.period=2 AND e.minute>=70 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: Who scored the most goals in La Liga 2015/16?
gold: SELECT player, goals FROM player_season WHERE competition='La Liga' AND season='2015/2016' ORDER BY goals DESC LIMIT 1

q: Who had the most tackles in the Premier League in 2024/25?
gold: SELECT player, tackles FROM player_season WHERE competition='Premier League' AND season='2024/2025' ORDER BY tackles DESC LIMIT 1

q: Who scored the most goals at the 2022 World Cup?
gold: SELECT p.player, sum(p.goals) g FROM player_match p JOIN matches m USING (match_id) WHERE m.competition='FIFA World Cup' AND m.season='2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: Which team scored the most goals in Serie A 2015/16?
gold: SELECT team, sum(n) g FROM (SELECT home_team team, home_score n FROM matches WHERE competition='Serie A' AND season='2015/2016' UNION ALL SELECT away_team, away_score FROM matches WHERE competition='Serie A' AND season='2015/2016') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many goals did Lionel Messi score in La Liga 2015/16?
gold: SELECT player, goals FROM player_season WHERE strip_accents(lower(player)) LIKE '%messi%' AND competition='La Liga' AND season='2015/2016'

q: Which player received the most yellow cards in Ligue 1 2015/16?
gold: SELECT player, yellow_cards FROM player_season WHERE competition='Ligue 1' AND season='2015/2016' ORDER BY yellow_cards DESC, player LIMIT 1

q: Who had the most assists at Euro 2024?
gold: SELECT player, assists FROM player_season WHERE competition='UEFA Euro' AND season='2024' ORDER BY assists DESC, player LIMIT 1

q: Which player had the highest total expected goals (xG) in the Premier League 2015/16, using StatsBomb's xG?
gold: SELECT s.player, round(sum(s.statsbomb_xg),2) x FROM shots s JOIN matches m USING (match_id) WHERE m.competition='Premier League' AND m.season='2015/2016' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: Who scored the most non-penalty goals above their expected goals in Serie A 2015/16, using this project's xG model, minimum 40 shots?
gold: SELECT s.player, round(sum(s.is_goal::INT)-sum(s.model_xg),1) d FROM shots s JOIN matches m USING (match_id) WHERE m.competition='Serie A' AND m.season='2015/2016' AND s.shot_type<>'Penalty' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>=40 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many matches are there in the 2024 MLS season data?
gold: SELECT 'MLS' x, count(*) n FROM matches WHERE competition='MLS' AND season='2024'

q: Who made the most interceptions in Bundesliga 2024/25?
gold: SELECT player, interceptions FROM player_season WHERE competition='Bundesliga' AND season='2024/2025' ORDER BY interceptions DESC, player LIMIT 1

q: Which goalkeeper made the most saves in La Liga 2024/25?
gold: SELECT player, saves FROM player_season WHERE competition='La Liga' AND season='2024/2025' ORDER BY saves DESC LIMIT 1

q: Which team won the most home matches in the Premier League 2024/25?
gold: SELECT home_team, count(*) n FROM matches WHERE competition='Premier League' AND season='2024/2025' AND home_score>away_score GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: Who scored the most headed goals in the Premier League 2015/16?
gold: SELECT s.player, count(*) n FROM shots s JOIN matches m USING (match_id) WHERE m.competition='Premier League' AND m.season='2015/2016' AND s.is_goal AND s.body_part='Head' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many goals were scored in total at the 2018 World Cup, not counting penalty shootouts?
gold: SELECT 'total' x, sum(home_score+away_score) n FROM matches WHERE competition='FIFA World Cup' AND season='2018'

q: Who completed the most dribbles in La Liga 2015/16?
gold: SELECT player, dribbles_completed FROM player_season WHERE competition='La Liga' AND season='2015/2016' ORDER BY dribbles_completed DESC LIMIT 1

q: Which player committed the most fouls in the last 15 minutes of Serie A matches in 2015/16?
gold: SELECT e.player, count(*) n FROM events e JOIN matches m USING (match_id) WHERE m.competition='Serie A' AND m.season='2015/2016' AND e.type='Foul' AND e.period=2 AND e.minute>=75 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: Who scored the most goals in Serie A 2024/25?
gold: SELECT player, goals FROM player_season WHERE competition='Serie A' AND season='2024/2025' ORDER BY goals DESC LIMIT 1

q: What was the score of the 2022 World Cup final?
gold: SELECT home_team, home_score, away_score FROM matches WHERE competition='FIFA World Cup' AND season='2022' AND stage='Final'

q: Which player took the most shots at Euro 2024?
gold: SELECT player, shots FROM player_season WHERE competition='UEFA Euro' AND season='2024' ORDER BY shots DESC LIMIT 1

q: In the Premier League 2015/16, which player had the most tackles per 90 minutes among players with at least 900 minutes?
gold: SELECT player, round(tackles*90.0/minutes,2) t FROM player_season WHERE competition='Premier League' AND season='2015/2016' AND minutes>=900 ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 1

q: Which defenders had a clean sheet if we're just counting the first half of home games in the 2016 Premier League season?
gold: SELECT p.player, count(*) n FROM player_match p JOIN team_match t ON t.match_id = p.match_id AND t.team = p.team WHERE t.competition='Premier League' AND t.season='2015/2016' AND t.venue='home' AND t.ht_goals_against = 0 AND p.position_group='Defender' AND p.minute_on = 0 AND (p.minute_off IS NULL OR p.minute_off >= 45) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1

q: Which goalkeeper kept the most clean sheets in La Liga 2015/16?
gold: SELECT p.player, count(*) n FROM player_match p JOIN team_match t ON t.match_id = p.match_id AND t.team = p.team WHERE t.competition='La Liga' AND t.season='2015/2016' AND t.goals_against = 0 AND p.position_group='Goalkeeper' AND p.minutes >= 60 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1
